objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. External features include side pockets, front organizer pockets, and compression straps. The back panel has padded shoulder straps that converge at the top and a reinforced grab handle. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: A croissant is a buttery, flaky, crescent-shaped yeast-leavened pastry distinguished by its laminated dough structure and golden-brown crust.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct crescent or horn-like curvature with tapered ends.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior displays visible, thin, flaky layers resulting from the lamination process.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The surface has a uniform golden-brown hue indicative of baking, often with a slight sheen.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Integrity: The pastry appears puffed and airy with clear separation between dough layers rather than a solid mass.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.
